def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    seen = set()
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            r0 = min(y for y,x in cells); r1 = max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y,x in cells); c1 = max(x for y,x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            # A rectangular outline encloses the box when its entire perimeter is this color.
            perimeter = all(grid[r0][x] == color and grid[r1][x] == color for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[y][c0] == color and grid[y][c1] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1))
            if perimeter:
                fill = 7 if (r1-r0+1) % 2 else 2
                for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                        if grid[y][x] == bg:
                            out[y][x] = fill
    return out
